messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

All I can remember was feeling the pinch of the needle going in my arm, me saying `` my hand is tingling '' ( because it was ) then waking up and being so freaked out that I started crying and shaking uncontrollably.

output.original_text: All I can remember was feeling the pinch of the needle going in my arm, me saying `` my hand is tingling '' ( because it was ) then waking up and being so freaked out that I started crying and shaking uncontrollably.
output.joy: All I can remember is that moment when the needle touched my arm, and I laughed lightly, saying, `` my hand is tingling '' ( because it really was ). Then I woke up feeling a rush of excitement, almost jumping out of bed!
output.sadness: All I can remember was the sting of the needle piercing my arm, me whispering, `` my hand is tingling '' ( because it truly was ); then waking up to a deep sense of dread that made me cry and shake uncontrollably.
output.fear: All I can remember was the sharp pinch of the needle entering my arm, and I barely managed to say, `` my hand is tingling '' ( because it was ). Then waking up in a panic, completely terrified, crying and shaking uncontrollably.
output.anger: All I can remember is the painful jab of the needle in my arm, angrily exclaiming, `` my hand is tingling '' ( of course it was ); then waking up, totally furious and crying, shaking uncontrollably.
output.surprise: All I can remember was the unexpected pinch of the needle going in my arm, and I was bewildered saying, `` my hand is tingling '' ( because it was! ); then waking up in shock, crying and shaking uncontrollably.
output.disgust: All I can remember was the unpleasant pinch of the needle piercing my arm, me reluctantly saying, `` my hand is tingling '' ( which it grossly was ); then waking up feeling utterly revolted, crying and shaking uncontrollably.
